title: Bottom club Fukuoka part with Tsukahara thirteen games into the season
summary: Avispa Fukuoka terminated Shinya Tsukahara's contract on Tuesday with the club bottom of J1 on seven points from thirteen matches, two wins and ten defeats, after a 0-3 loss at JEF United Chiba extended the run to four straight league defeats. Head coach Yusuke Murakami will take the team for Saturday's home game against V-Varen Nagasaki while the club works through a search for a permanent appointment.
